rationale: The stock is trading near the top of its intraday range (87.3%) after a significant gap-down, indicating that the initial selling pressure has been absorbed but there is no fresh momentum to drive a continuation higher. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward profile due to the proximity to the session high and the lack of volume expansion in the last few minutes, while shorting against the current upward drift from the lows is counter-trend.
